text:
The image is a powerful, dramatic and detailed art portrait of two dragon-like creatures view 3/4 — one huge, armed "dragon warrior" and the other, smaller but no less aggressive "dragon dog" - against the backdrop of a ruined ancient city. The composition is filled with tension, dictates a sense of danger and grandeur. The color palette is warm, with a predominance of orange, black, green and brown tones — it creates the atmosphere of a sunset or a hot evening in a post-apocalyptic world.
1. The dragon warrior (in the center of the composition): It is a giant, muscular creature with black scaly skin resembling a dragon or goblin. He has a powerful physique, a shirtless torso covered with prominent muscles and patterns on the skin. The head is decorated with sharp, branching spikes and bone horns. The eyes are bright orange, burning, with a sinister look. Clothing/equipment: Heavy leather and metal armor with decorative round plates and symbols on the chest. On the belt is a massive belt with a central medallion. Socks on the feet, as well as sleeves on the arms, are dark brown, leather or metal bracers and shoulder pads. He grips tightly the curved sword he holds in front of him. Wings: Huge, leathery black wings with bone edges and sharp spikes spread behind the back. They look powerful and ready to take off or attack. The creature combines grandeur and cruelty, but its posture and facial expression (with its mouth open) can be interpreted as threatening or even irritated.
2. The Lesser Dragon (on the right): A smaller but,with a flatter muzzle no less aggressive "dragon dog" with orange eyes and scaly skin of a greenish-brown color. He also has spikes on his head, but he looks more aggressive and insane. He stands in a tense pose, with his mouth open, exposing long, sharp teeth. It looks like it's ready to attack or scream. There are leather belts and collars with metal buckles on the neck and body. This dragon looks like a brave guardian or guard ready to protect its master.
Background: A ruined city with fragments of columns, broken walls and ruins. The remains of ancient buildings, possibly temples or palaces, are visible, which emphasizes the epic and historical depth. The orange-golden sky with soft clouds creates the impression of sunset, which gives the image a gloomy but beautiful atmosphere. The lighting is directed from the sky, softly illuminating the characters and emphasizing the relief of their bodies, skin and armor details.
An image in the style of digital painting or fantasy illustration. The artist used high detail — every scale, thorn on the wing, eyes, armor are carefully worked out.
